question: Does the draft new/storage/google-cloud-storage-archive.json (Archive storage class) need its own record?
why: Archive is a paid storage class of the same Cloud Storage product with no free allowance of its own (the Free Tier covers regional storage in us-east1, us-west1 and us-central1 only); the existing record keeps verdict fails-quota and identity card, so the draft is folded into it
